lines.zh: 我沿着冷海的海底滑行。
lines.en: I glide along the floor of the cold sea.

lines.zh: 甲壳分开水，水自己让路。
lines.en: My shell parts the water, and the water yields.
I walk along the ice's edge.
Four pairs of limbs take turns gripping.

lines.zh: 我走到浅滩，水只没过膝盖。
lines.en: I reach the shallows; water only reaches my knees.

lines.zh: 每一步都带着细微的咔嗒。
lines.en: Each step ticks faintly.
I head toward warmth.
Coral bits still cling to my back.

lines.zh: 我把身体压低，避开洋流。
lines.en: I keep low to avoid the current.
The kelp bends under me and springs back.
I go around a whole reef.
My shell is small, but very hard.

lines.zh: 我一路都朝着岸的方向。
lines.en: All the way, I head for shore.

lines.zh: 露出来的岩石我爬过去。
lines.en: I climb over the rocks that show.
I slide down quickly.
Then I steady again.

lines.zh: 我停在水里，鳃缓慢开合。
lines.en: I stop in the water; gills open and close slowly.
The ice above glows white.
I look up at that light.
My limbs sift the sand gently.

lines.zh: 有鱼从旁边过，我没有动。
lines.en: A fish passes; I do not move.
Let it come closer.
It leaves.
I draw my shell tight.
No water seeps through the seams.
I am waiting for the tide.
And for something else.
The ice creaks far off.

lines.zh: 我听过这种声音很多次。
lines.en: I have heard that sound many times.
That is not ice cracking.

lines.zh: 我从水里冒出头，只露出眼。
lines.en: I surface, only my eyes showing.
You stand on the ice; I see you clearly.
I rise slowly.

lines.zh: 甲壳上的水一道一道流。
lines.en: Water runs off my shell in lines.

lines.zh: 你手里那东西反着冷光。
lines.en: That thing in your hand throws a cold gleam.
That is not fish.

lines.zh: 我把头偏过去，又偏回来。
lines.en: I tilt my head aside, then back again.
I rest a forelimb on the ice edge.
The ice holds.
I am measuring the distance.

lines.zh: 甲壳裂了一线，我立刻合上。
lines.en: A seam cracks; I seal it at once.
I am knocked into a slide.

lines.zh: 蓝血从我壳缝里涌出来。
lines.en: Blue blood wells out of my shell seams.
I turn to face you.
This does not hurt.
I slide back half a step.

lines.zh: 我把断掉的节肢收回来。
lines.en: I draw back a broken limb.
The shell still holds.
I fix on you.
That hit will stay with me a while.
That smell carries the reek of dry land.
I eat only from the sea.
But it is moving.
I reach out a forelimb and touch it.
It rolls once.
I nudge it again.
Not food.

lines.zh: 我用前肢把它拨回你脚边。
lines.en: I flick it back to your feet with a forelimb.
There's something alive under the ice.
I turn and dive back.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的壳，差点滑倒。
lines.en: You step on my shell and nearly slip.
I stay pinned in place, not an inch back.

lines.zh: 你撞在我背上，膝盖磕了一下。
lines.en: You hit my back and knock your knee.
I swing my shell around to face you.
My shell scrapes your boot.
I slide off the ice edge.
And climb back up.
I bring a sheet of water up with me.
You move back.
I keep crawling along beneath the ice.
I do such things only in deep water.
It is too cold beneath the ice.
What I want is down in the deep.
I head deeper.
The scent of my kind is there.
I follow it.
The deeper, the darker.
But I can see.
I open my shell a little.
The current passes through.
I clamp it with a forelimb.
A corner breaks in my grip.
I lift it up against the ice-light.
This is stone.
I drop it back in the water.
This one has a scent.
I tuck it under a shell seam.
No one will find it.
I swim off.
It rattles inside.
I smell blood in the water.
My own blood.
I turn my head slowly toward the sound.
I remember who swung first.
My shell closes; every seam seals.
I follow the smell of blood over.
Not fast, but relentless.
Beneath the ice is mine.
Come down and it is my turn.
I press against the ice.
I circle the ice pillar.
You take a step; I swim one.

lines.zh: 我沉到你看不见的深度。
lines.en: I sink below your sight.
And surface on the other side.
My shell darkens in the water.
The water hides me.
I reach a forelimb out.
Almost.
You back up to the ice edge and I stop.
I follow along the ice edge.
My forelimb falls and the ice cracks.
My shell strikes your leg.
I clamp your foot with my limbs.

lines.zh: 我这一击把冰水泼你满脸。
lines.en: My blow throws icy water across your face.
I clamp onto it and drag it into deeper water.
In water I am stronger.
It breaks loose.
I lunge again.
A shell edge rakes past.
It backs to the ice rim.
A blue light kindles under the ice.
Then I break through.
Broken ice falls over me.
I shake my shell.
Cold wind does not touch me.
I look toward the shore.
There are warm things there.
I climb out slowly.
The ice takes my print.
My first breath is very cold.

lines.zh: 火在水面上烧，我的壳发烫。
lines.en: Fire burns on the water; my shell heats.

lines.zh: 我从冰崖上摔下来，壳磕了一下。
lines.en: I fall from an ice cliff and knock my shell.
Water is my home.
The blast flips me in a column of water.

lines.zh: 那东西卡在我的壳缝里。
lines.en: It jams in a seam of my shell.

lines.zh: 咒力钻进甲壳，我甩不掉。
lines.en: Magic works into my shell; I cannot shake it.
Hungry enough to bite through ice.
Lightning falls; the water carries it off.

lines.zh: 我被拖进没有水的黑里。
lines.en: I am dragged into a blackness with no water.
